remarks: Bright and professional office space available in the heart of downtown Stamford. This 1100 sq ft first-floor suite is located in a charming colonial-style building, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere for your business. The layout includes 4 rooms, ideal for offices or meeting spaces, along with one and a half bathrooms and a convenient kitchenette area. The space is equipped with central air for year-round comfort and includes on-site parking for added convenience. Perfect for small businesses, professional services, or creative workspaces looking for a well-located and character-filled setting with easy access to downtown amenities, restaurants, and transportation.
